ARBITER: main analysis results

Methods

The benchmark includes 102 trials from 16 meta-analyses. Models were Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5, effort medium, using Claude Code 2.1.278 and isolated configuration homes. ARBITER 1.0.0 (public commit 2f549ae) was used. Sonnet with ARBITER ran on 12 October 2026; other arms ran on 14 October 2026. Each arm ran each trial once; run-to-run variability is not estimated. Prompts differ by the skill invocation and the Unassisted output-format instruction; templates and a filled example are in the supplement. Proposed results were approved unchanged. Up to two uncoached Continue replies per phase were permitted.

Only consensus-discordant win share is confirmatory. Intervals use 10,000 percentile bootstrap replicates, resampling trials within meta-analysis, seed 20261018. Missing judgements count as wrong. No p-values or multiplicity corrections are used. The composite excludes split cells and substitutes consensus preferred judgements on consensus cells. Adjudicators could only choose among the three offered labels. Cells where both Sonnet arms matched Published were never adjudicated and are assumed correct. Both features inflate absolute composite values; composite accuracy must not be an accuracy claim in the abstract.

Figure 1: architecture and draft trace

The trace uses a consensus cell where ARBITER-Sonnet matched the preferred judgement and differed from the meta label. Four more-severe candidates where only ARBITER departed from meta, plus levin-2016 D2, with cited bundle passages, evidence identifiers, source/page locators, verification status and abbreviated answer sets are in worked-trace-candidates.csv. The default is award-10-2018 D2. The trace shows the span binding to its hash-identified captured source and the recorded independent bundle verifier result. The displayed selection is provisional for author review.

Figure 3. Blinded adjudication

Among 62 consensus cells where the arms differed, ARBITER won 54, Unassisted won 7, and neither won 1. ARBITER’s win share was 54/62 (87.1%) (0.79–0.94) (95% CI).

Values are n/N (%) (95% CI, bounds as proportions). Domain consistency for ARBITER refers to proposals; recorded overrides are separate. Departure = violation + invalid path. One Unassisted domain has no evaluable label/answer set and is excluded (509 evaluable). Overall consistency is exact worst-domain agreement; permitted escalations are separate. Evidence binding counts distinct identities cited by current active answers. Text spans are server-extracted; visual regions are server-rendered and hash-bound, but transcriptions are model-written and not checked against images. Bundle verification is structural, not evidence of clinical correctness or completion. Unassisted evidence traces, proposed judgements and recorded overrides are not available. RoB 2, risk of bias tool for randomised trials. CI, confidence interval; 10,000 percentile bootstrap replicates, trials resampled within meta-analysis; seed 20261018.

ARBITER proposals reproduce all 510 Sonnet and 505 observed Haiku domain judgements from the official algorithms. Sonnet has no recorded override. Haiku has one recorded override (hill-2017 D1, Low to Some concerns); its rationale is in the supplement. Evidence binding and bundle verification are structural checks and do not establish clinical correctness.

Figure 5. Decisive signalling questions

The primary localisation population contains 10 ARBITER and 47 Unassisted losses. Cells may contribute several decisive questions. Jointly decisive sets do not contribute individual-question counts. Class counts and the sensitivity population are supplementary.

Time and reconstructed cost

Time per trial was 7.6 [6.1 to 10.5] minutes for ARBITER and 0.5 [0.4 to 0.5] minutes for Unassisted (median [IQR]); the paired mean difference was 11.0 (8.4–14.1) minutes (95% CI). Reconstructed API list-price cost per trial was US$3.78 [3.46 to 4.10] and US$0.09 [0.07 to 0.13], respectively; the paired mean difference was US$3.68 (3.61–3.75) (95% CI). These are list-price equivalents, not expenditure. The supplement gives process metrics, cost bounds and Haiku analyses.

Supplementary material

Supplement.docx contains numbered eTables and eFigures and the methods appendix. TRIPOD-LLM.docx contains a checklist skeleton with GRRAS items, for author completion. Legends and alt text are in figure-legends.md.
